description: [1HLabs Autonomous Wallet Allowance & Circuit Breaker Escrow (#81)] Non-custodial, programmable spending limit vault governed under Swiss CO Art. 14 and Swiss DLT Act Art. 973d. Eliminates prompt-injection wallet drainage and runaway execution costs for autonomous crypto wallets (Exodus, Solana, Lightning, Base USDC). Hard-capped 3,600s TTL with automated clawback.

auto_refund_on_failure.description: Automatically return unspent funds on timeout or failure

dry_run.description: Zero-risk simulation mode. When true, returns locked preview quote with settlement_token without debiting wallet.

parent_wallet_pubkey.description: Parent crypto wallet public key / address in Exodus or Solana/Bitcoin/EVM

settlement_token.description: Optional dry-run settlement token (tok_dry_...) to redeem a previously locked preview quote.

task_budget_cap.description: Maximum spending ceiling authorized for this autonomous task session

task_objective_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the agent objective binding the allowance

ttl_seconds.description: Session TTL in seconds (strictly capped at 3,600s against wallet drain)

wallet_protocol.description: Underlying blockchain / wallet rail of the autonomous agent

name: 1hlabs_agent_allowance_circuit_breaker
